rows.experience: Minimum 1 year of professional experience in core algorithms, NLP, CV, ASR, OCR, and generative models.
Minimum 1 year of professional experience in developing and optimizing ML/DL models.
Minimum 1 year of professional experience in wrapping AI models into usable APIs, SDKs, and enterprise integrations (using tools like Apigee, Kong, etc.).
Minimum 1 year of professional experience with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure), cloud integration, and configuration.
Minimum 1 year of professional experience in model deployment automation, pipeline orchestration, and monitoring (e.g., MLflow, Kubeflow, etc.).

Minimum 01 year of hands-on experience in graphic design, video editing, multimedia production, or a related field; proficiency in Canva, Adobe Premiere Pro, CorelDRAW, Adobe Photoshop, After Effects, or similar tools.
Minimum 01 year of hands-on experience in content creation, social media management, digital marketing, or digital communications.
Minimum 01 year of professional experience in customer/client onboarding. Preference to candidates with expertise in Customer Engagement and Customer Portfolio Management.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply for DIBD Recruitment 2026?
content_sections.text: Other conditions: Internship or training experience will not be considered as experience. Minimum required experience is counted as of the last date of application submission. Desirable: Posts 1-5: preference for Computer Science, AI, Information Technology or related fields. Creative Design & Multimedia and Content & Social Media: preferably an MBA or equivalent; academic background in Marketing, Mass Communication, Communications, Graphic Design, Multimedia, Film Studies, Digital Media or a related discipline preferred. Support/Onboarding: preferably MBA in Marketing or equivalent; preference for expertise in Customer Engagement and Customer Portfolio Management.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Purely contractual for 1 year from date of joining the assignment or co-terminus with the project, whichever is earlier. Further continuation subject to project requirements and satisfactory performance. Positions are purely temporary; no right or claim to permanent appointment. DIBD, DIC may terminate with one month's notice or without notice by paying one month's salary in lieu. Terms of engagement follow NITI guidelines no. A-12036/2/2023-Adm.IB dated 07.07.2023.
